ℹ️ About OmniHost☰
☰

OmniHost is a single HTML file that works as a complete personal productivity app. No server, no account, no cloud — just open this file in any modern browser.

✅ Make it yours — add your notes, tasks, bookmarks, and data. Click 💾 Save to download a copy with everything baked in.

🌐 Works offline — runs entirely in your browser with JavaScript and CSS. No internet needed after the first load.

🔒 Your data stays yours — nothing is sent anywhere. The file is your database.

🔄 Start fresh — go to Settings → Clean Quine to reset everything and choose your language.

⬡ OmniHost · 141 Modules · Single-File Quine · Inspired by YunoHost · About the Author

🌀 Galaxy

The Milky Way — 13.6 billion years of galactic evolution
~13.6 Gya
Milky Way begins forming
One of the oldest galaxies. Proto-galactic fragments merge in the young universe.
~13.2 Gya
Oldest known stars form
Metal-poor halo stars like HD 140283 form in the galactic halo.
~11–12 Gya
Major merger events
The Milky Way absorbs dwarf galaxies, including Gaia-Enceladus-Sausage.
~10 Gya
Thick disk forms
Star formation in the thick disk with older, metal-poor stars.
~8–10 Gya
Thin disk forms
The familiar spiral disk where the Sun will eventually form.
~6 Gya
Central bar structure forms
The Milky Way develops its barred-spiral morphology.
~4.6 Gya
The Sun is born
A molecular cloud collapses in an Orion Arm spiral. Our solar system forms.
Present
Today — 100–400 billion stars
We orbit 26,000 ly from center at ~220 km/s. Galactic year ≈ 225 Myr.
~4.5 Gyr hence
Andromeda collision (Milkomeda)
Milky Way and Andromeda merge into a giant elliptical galaxy.
~100 trillion yr
Last stars die
Star formation ceases. The galaxy goes dark.
